test.create_query: CREATE TABLE symbol_addresses (address UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO symbol_addresses SELECT address_begin FROM system.symbols ORDER BY sipHash64(address_begin), address_begin LIMIT 1000
test.query: WITH (SELECT groupArray(address) FROM symbol_addresses) AS addresses SELECT count() FROM numbers(3000000) WHERE NOT ignore(addressToSymbol(addresses[1 + cityHash64(number) % 1000])) SETTINGS max_threads = 1

WITH (SELECT groupArray(address) FROM symbol_addresses) AS addresses SELECT count() FROM numbers_mt(24000000) WHERE NOT ignore(addressToSymbol(addresses[1 + cityHash64(number) % 1000])) SETTINGS max_threads = 8
